:::{#exm-density-limit}
#### The uniform density as a limit

For $X \sim \text{Uniform}(0, 1)$ and $x \in [0, 1)$,
$\Pr(x \le X < x + \change) = \change$ once $\change \le 1 - x$, so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x)
&= \lim_{\change \downarrow 0} \frac{\change}{\change} \\
&= 1
\end{aligned}
$$

For $x < 0$ or $x > 1$, the interval eventually misses $[0, 1]$, so the limit is $0$.
Both agree with the density of @def-uniform.

:::
